title: Shaping AI's Beliefs Before It Generates: Human Sense of Agency in Creative AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.21405v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI systems for creative media generation expand human capabilities yet risk diminishing human agency. A core problem is anchoring, where the user's thinking becomes anchored to a polished, generated artifact, shifting the user's role from active authoring to reactive editing. We propose pre-generation belief controls that can empower creators to inspect, revise, and steer the AI's interpretation before any media is generated, so that the initial anchor is set by the human. We formalize four design principles and instantiate them in the Proactive Co-Creator (PaCC), a system for early-stage conceptual ideation and prototyping that proactively surfaces its assumptions and uncertainty through clarifications, belief graphs, and media attributes, inviting users to shape the AI's beliefs before generating the final outcome. translated_title: 在AI生成之前塑造其信念：创意AI中的人类能动感
translated_abstract: 用于创意媒体生成的AI系统拓展了人类的能力，却也带来了削弱人类能动性的风险。其中核心问题是“锚定效应”，即用户的思维被固定在一个已生成的精致作品上，使其角色从主动创作者转变为被动修改者。我们提出了“生成前信念控制”，使创作者能够在任何媒体被生成之前检查、修订并引导AI对需求的理解，从而让最初的锚点由人类来设定。我们将这一理念形式化为四项设计原则，并将其实现于Proactive Co-Creator（PaCC）系统中——这是一个面向早期概念构思与原型设计的系统，它通过澄清式提问、信念图谱和媒体属性主动呈现自身的假设与不确定性，邀请用户在生成最终成果之前塑造AI的信念。我们将PaCC作为设计探针，在一项小规模单组探索性用户研究中观察到，参与者报告了d（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“生成前信念控制”理念并实现了PaCC系统，让用户能在AI生成媒体之前检查并塑造AI的信念与假设，从而以人类设定初始锚点的方式保护创意过程中的能动性。
